2020s internet slang
I brought this disaster upon myself.
You ignored every warning. Now you are standing in the mess you made with your own hands.
2020s lifestyle slang
A disciplined, productive, admirable life.
Wake up early, exercise, study Korean, prepare lunch, and still arrive at work on time.
2022 sports & gaming meme
What matters is an unbreakable spirit.
Your team is far behind, but nobody gives up before the final whistle.
2010s–2020s public discourse
One rule for me, another for you.
He complains when others are five minutes late, but expects everyone to wait when he is late.
2020s reaction meme
This might actually be better!
You miss the crowded bus in the rain—then the next one gives you a luxury empty seat.
late 2010s–2020s slang
Handle it well, neatly, and with good sense—without being told every detail.
You give one short instruction. Your coworker understands the whole situation and delivers perfectly.
2000s comparison culture
The impossibly perfect ‘friend’s son’ your mother compares you with.
Your family praises someone else’s grades, job, manners, cooking, and fitness—all during dinner.
2020s aesthetic slang
It just has a nice vibe.
You cannot explain why, but the café’s colors, music, light, and tableware all feel right.
CONSUMER CULTURE REMIX
Even something common is nowhere to be found exactly when you need it.
CAFÉ SIZE REMIX
You give a little but get much more back—often as punishment or loss.
MEME WORDPLAY
The wiser or more accomplished a person becomes, the more humble they should be.
PERFORMANCE MEME
Long exposure to an environment can teach you something, even without formal study.
CAN’T-RESIST MEME
People cannot easily pass by something they love or habitually enjoy.
COMMUNITY POST TITLE
Careless confidence that ‘it probably won’t happen’ can cause real trouble.
GENERATION MEME
Older folks start ‘back in my day’ stories—sometimes flexing how hard or glorious those days were.
PERFORMANCE MEME
Everyone has at least one thing they can do well.
A grinning beachgoer digs a deep sand hole right beside a no-digging warning sign
The same person sits trapped in the hole as sand pours down on him, still holding the shovel
One woman moves through dawn: waking up, jogging, studying Korean, packing lunch
The same woman sits calmly at her office desk at 9am with a packed lunch and checked planner
Home team sits crushed on the bench under a 1–9 scoreboard near full time
Despite a 1–9 score near full time, the team huddles with clenched fists and fighting spirit
A man arrives late at 9:05 smiling casually while coworkers check their watches
At the same 9:05, he angrily points at the clock as another coworker rushes in late
A tired office worker sighs at a rainy bus stop as his bus pulls away
Minutes later he smiles in a plush luxury bus seat with coffee by the window
A manager points at a messy one-circle scribble with a vague ‘you know what I mean’ gesture
A coworker presents a polished chart deck; the manager looks amazed while she gives an OK sign
At dinner, a glowing multi-talented perfect friend’s son floats behind two slumped adult children
Mom shows a suit photo on her phone while her daughter rolls her eyes mid-bite
Two friends open the door of an ordinary-looking street cafe, curious about what’s inside
Inside, warm light, plants, and pretty cups give them an unexplained good vibe
A shopper stares at an empty pharmacy shelf marked SOLD OUT while holding a shopping list
A pharmacist shrugs as expensive supplements remain fully stocked on the counter
A barista hands a tiny Tall-labeled cup across the cafe counter
The same barista returns an absurdly oversized Grande cup; the customer looks shocked
A proud man stands chin-up beside stiff green rice while ripe golden rice bows in the field
The same man bows deeply among bowed ripe rice, hat and pride left on the path
A bored dog yawns on a mat in the corner of a traditional village school
The same dog does calligraphy with a brush while astonished students and teacher watch
A sparrow banks hard toward spilled grain outside a traditional mill
The same sparrow lands on the grain pile at the mill entrance, unable to resist
A hiker waves casually beside a cliff danger sign, brushing off the warning
Later at a cafe, he animatedly tells friends the story while everyone cracks up
An older man lectures at dinner while younger relatives look bored and check phones
Above him float exaggerated old-days scenes, including a tiger smoking a pipe
A grub rolls like a champion athlete before a wildly cheering crowd

You can never find a thing when you need it.
From rags to riches.

Every cloud has a silver lining.
Hard work pays off.
Every dog has its day.
Pie in the sky.
The grass is always greener on the other side.
Doesn’t know A from B.

proverbs.en: Walls have ears.
A piece of cake.
Sow the wind, reap the whirlwind.
It takes two to tango.

proverbs.en: Don’t count your chickens before they hatch.

proverbs.en: The pot calling the kettle black.
Where there’s a will, there’s a way.

proverbs.en: Kind words go a long way.
Many hands make light work.
The fuller the ear, the lower it bows.
We eat with our eyes first.
Too many cooks spoil the broth.

proverbs.en: You pick things up by osmosis.
Famous last words.
Old habits die hard.
Shutting the stable door after the horse has bolted.
You get what you pay for.

proverbs.en: If at first you don’t succeed, try, try again.
A frog in a well.
Grin and bear it.
Even Homer sometimes nods.
You dug your own grave.

Like a moth to a flame.
You reap what you sow.
Share and share alike.
Many a little makes a mickle.
A word to the wise is enough.
Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
Back in my day.
